source.capture: each case runs exe/ukiryu (Ukiryu::Cli.start) in a fresh Ruby process; the capture script is kept with the K22-CLI-INSPECT task evidence
source.context: env -i; HOME, PATH and UKIRYU_REGISTER are per-case temp dirs ({HOME}, {BIN}, {REGISTER}); PATH holds symlinks for the listed bins plus `which` on unix hosts; macos/windows rows set RbConfig host_os (darwin23/mingw32) before loading ukiryu
